questions.question: Clarify the description of Abel’s work on integral equations, the learned society named in the biography and the attribution of the quotations.

localizations.source: Clarify the description of Abel’s work on integral equations, the learned society named in the biography and the attribution of the quotations.
localizations.ru: Уточнить описание работ Абеля по интегральным уравнениям, название научного общества и атрибуцию цитат.

questions.resolution: The broad priority claim was replaced by the specific reference to Abel’s integral equation; the society name was regularized, the appointment described as temporary teaching work, and the unsourced quotations were paraphrased or explicitly qualified as traditional attribution.

questions.question: For the portrait of Niels Henrik Abel, identify the artist or source work, a public source record and the licence or public-domain basis. Holding a copy in the author’s archive does not establish authorship of a third-party historical image.

localizations.source: For the portrait of Niels Henrik Abel, identify the artist or source work, a public source record and the licence or public-domain basis. Holding a copy in the author’s archive does not establish authorship of a third-party historical image.
localizations.ru: Для портрета Нильса Хенрика Абеля указать автора или исходное произведение, публичный источник и лицензию либо основание общественного достояния. Наличие копии в авторском архиве не подтверждает авторство исторического изображения третьего лица.
